The rules this directory plays by

Every link on this page goes straight to the official organization's own website. This directory earns no commissions, contains no affiliate or tracking parameters, and never suggests a purchase.

  • Free here means the instructions, manuals, diagrams or recall data. Replacement parts are a separate, always-optional cost.
  • This page is a single HTML file. Save it anywhere and open it without internet; the data travels with it.

Built by Asdale Dynamics, LLC under the MIT license. If a link goes stale or a formerly-free resource starts charging, the data file records source_checked_date and recheck_date per card so freshening is part of the design. Nothing here is sponsored; no company reviewed its card before publication.
